authorization: etymologise remaining Indo-Aryan surveys. do not rebuild. work autonomously and do what you can, you have 8 hours, i will review once your time is done.

proposals.evidence: Turner identifies the ḍa extension of jīvā separately, with Punjabi jeuṛī/jeuṛā, Kumaoni jyoṛo, Nepali jiuri, Bihari jaurī and Gujarati jevrī. The Dotyali/eastern and Haryanvi/Mewari forms fit this extended rope family, with regional rhotic/lateral/retroflex realizations. This does not include the ambiguous joḍā response or the SSNP y-spelling requiring its own font check.

proposals.evidence: Turner explicitly gives Kumaoni kuco brush and Gangoli kuċ broomstick, with Nepali kuco brush/broom. Dotyali kutso has the corresponding affricate written ts and the same broom sense; this fits kūrca rather than the other unrelated broom roots.
